$comment: Default look, v0. Lengths are laid out on a 1920×1080 stage and rendered at stage.output (2560×1440), so 1 here is 1.33 video pixels; times in frames at 60 fps.

dots.$comment: The close, minimize and zoom buttons, macOS's colours, each with the thin darker ring macOS draws (outlineWidth wide, inside the circle).

cursor.$comment: The cursor shows whatever the page asks for (its CSS cursor), drawn at the page's scale. art "system": macOS's own cursors, read from the Mac Take runs on. Without it, or off a Mac, the shapes below (size in CSS pixels of the page, hotspots on the SVGs' 30-unit grid) and the arrow for every other cursor. The cursor hides when typing starts and comes back when it moves, fading over hideFade frames.

caret.$comment: The text caret is drawn from the event log. Width is in CSS pixels of the recorded page (1, like Chrome's). Solid for solidFrames after it moves (while typing), then blinks blinkFrames on, blinkFrames off, like Chrome's 0.5 s blink.

loop.$comment: After the take's last frame, the footage crossfades back to the first frame and the cursor glides back to where it started.
